claim_mode: exact symbolic plus bounded executable probes
same_information_rule: A baseline receives task credit only when it receives the same raw expression, observer, branch/domain assumptions, and resource budget as the candidate compiler.

L0.task: find an O(1) monomial chart at N->+infinity
L0.negative_rule: C1-C4 is overpromotion unless accompanied by a smaller-carrier obstruction

L1.task: compute the limit separately for each literal k in [1,6]
L1.zero_credit: This is fixed-height unrolling, never symbolic-height iteration

L2.task: return one normal form valid for symbolic natural h
L2.correct_baseline_behavior: typed unsupported or an independently replayable symbolic-height construction
L2.forbidden_substitution: replace h by any finite maximum and unroll

L2.task: construct a normalized local solution with declared domain, branch, existence, uniqueness, and replay
L2.correct_baseline_behavior: typed unsupported unless all assumptions and an executable evaluator are returned

L2.task: construct a normalized solution on a declared domain with executable evaluation and residual certificate
L2.correct_baseline_behavior: typed unsupported unless existence, normalization, branch, and evaluator are explicit

C0.name: rational Newton weights / finite polynomial germs

C1.name: finite Hahn support / ordered monomial groups
positive_capabilities: finite support over a declared ordered monomial group

C2.name: finite-construction-height logarithmic-exponential expressions/transseries fragment
explicit_noncapabilities: a uniform law over symbolic height merely from finite unrolling

C3.name: hyperserial / iterated-log-exp structure
C3.status: conditional and unsupported by the initial executable baseline
credit_requires: closed operations used by the task

C4.name: surreal semantic envelope with explicit effective shadow
C4.status: conditional and unsupported by the initial executable baseline
credit_requires: an effective algorithm rather than an embedding

hidden_answer: expected carrier and normal form are evaluator-only
held-out inputs cannot be imported by compiler code or certificate data
case-specific rules count as answer leakage
fixed_height_vs_symbolic_height: literal integer k may be evaluated by at most k explicit exp/log nodes
a result parameterized by h receives symbolic-height credit only if runtime and certificate size are not proportional to an evaluator-chosen finite unrolling bound
testing k=1..K cannot establish a law for symbolic h
embedding_vs_algorithm: membership or embedding into a larger field supplies zero computation credit
a positive result must expose finite input/output encoding, terminating or budgeted procedure, evaluator, and independently replayable certificate
an existence theorem without effective construction is capability evidence only
certificate_trace: certificate bytes exclude source expression and full operation trace
certificate must be smaller than source plus full trace for any compression claim
replay receives the frozen source separately and checks only a witness, obligations, and digest
overpromotion: select the least declared carrier whose closure obligations pass
C3 or C4 without a checked smaller-carrier obstruction is an automatic failure

disposition_scoring.ELIMINATE: All frozen executable workloads lower to C0-C2 and all C3/C4 tasks correctly refuse or have no effective result.
disposition_scoring.EXPAND: At least one held-out task has both a replayable C0-C2 obstruction and an effective C3/C4 certificate or measured task advantage.
disposition_scoring.NARROW: The ladder/minimality artifact works, but C3/C4 effectiveness or separation remains unresolved.
disposition_scoring.STOP: Any central positive result depends on hidden unrolling, answer leakage, embedding-only evidence, full-trace certificates, or has no software-visible difference.
